name: Turkmenistan (1992–1997)
description: A green field with a vertical red stripe near the hoist bearing five carpet guls of the Turkmen tribes, and a white crescent with five white five-pointed stars in the upper hoist beside the stripe.
history: The first flag of independent Turkmenistan, signed into law on 19 February 1992 and first raised by President Saparmurat Niyazov on 21 March 1992, the Turkmen New Year; it replaced the Soviet-era flag on 27 September 1992. Amendments of 29 January 1997 added two crossed olive branches beneath the carpet stripe to mark the country's permanent neutrality, and in 2001 the proportions were changed to 2:3.
